items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: So the place he called me up and taught me to play with the Zulus with him. He told me it was a short hour... So I told him no I'd rather not bother with it. So the place he called me up and taught me to play with the Zulus with him.

ctx.x: Yeah he just died about four or five years ago. He died up in Michigan. Yeah I never endured him. Yeah he taught him many fellas around you know what I mean. Like Anderson and all them boys they all come up onto him you know. They tried to dap his eye there but he was one of the greats right now.
And how long did you play with that band? Joe Everett.
